title: A valid bearer with a Toast-Restaurant-External-ID naming no connected restaurant is a 404 ErrorMessage

source.note: The page documents 404 as 'You are attempting to access an unknown resource' and says nothing about the Toast-Restaurant-External-ID header; the orders specification's 404 on POST /orders/v2/orders ('An entity referenced in the order does not exist, or belongs to a restaurant the authenticated client ...') is the nearest documented analogue and is what the unit follows (toast/auth.py labels the status a judgment; a missing header is a 400 there, also a judgment). The ErrorMessage shape is the page's example.
